findings.title: Legacy startup script times out early
findings.result: MGS wait limit is about 145-170 s instead of 300 s because the loop counts iterations, not seconds; the same bug made the LNET wait about 11 s instead of 60 s.
findings.evidence: 13:14 cold start (8/10 failed), legacy run 3 (Compute-2 FATAL after 145 s)

findings.title: Head-1 (MGS) is always the last node up
findings.result: Head-1 reaches the OS about 190 s after its own power-on versus about 90 s for the other blades; every cold start depends on this gap.

findings.title: Fix verified
findings.result: With wall-clock deadlines the computes waited up to 344 s for the MGS (Head-1 held 240 s) and all 10 nodes mounted with 0 fatal retries; the legacy script would have failed at about 145 s.

findings.title: Data integrity across unclean power-off
findings.result: 40 of 40 files (256 MB each, written with direct I/O) sha256-identical after each of 2 hard power-offs of all 10 nodes.

findings.title: OST recovery window after unclean stop
findings.result: After a hard stop of all nodes only 2 of 16 OSTs were visible for another 275-292 s after all nodes reported mounted (OST recovery window 5:00; MDT mounted with abort_recov reconnects as a new client and is denied). After a graceful shutdown the pool was complete immediately. Accepted, not changed: production shutdowns are scheduled.

findings.title: Kernel update would break the boot
findings.result: dnf update installed the Rocky 9.8 kernel on Compute-2 and UPDATEDEFAULT=yes made it the boot default; the node came up without Lustre modules. Fixed with kernel* excluded in the update playbook and UPDATEDEFAULT=no on all nodes.
